svg.title: A common likelihood peak and three evidence integrals

cc:Work.dc:title: A common likelihood peak and three evidence integrals
cc:Work.dc:description: Dashed likelihood curves are identical. Shaded likelihood times proper prior areas are full data evidences; the likelihood and integrand have different units. The broad prior has a smaller area than the middle prior.
